evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: This raises the question of whether they can also carry out control system design.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: In this paper, we consider control system design as a task for LLM agents and grade the designed controller as control engineers do: the controller is given in a single Python file mapping measurements to actions, evaluated on held-out seeds against an ordered set of requirements, under specified physical perturbations and structural certificates, without using neural networks.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: We formulate the task as a chance-constrained feasibility problem and instantiate it in ControlHarbor, a benchmark of 44 tasks over 13 plants, which includes network consensus, vehicle platooning, the MuJoCo hopper, walker and humanoid.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: When robustness is part of the specification, a structured design meets it at the RL return on the humanoid task, where domain-randomised RL does not; under large pushes, domain-randomised RL succeeds and no designed controller does.
